_meta.title: PMI Stage 5.4B controlled resource demonstration
_meta.status: HYPOTHETICAL SCHEDULING FIXTURE - not an IFC-validated construction case. No IFC model supports these quantities. All engineering approvals remain PENDING.
_meta.sensitivity: DEMO-H1: identical to controlled_resource_demo/fixture_inputs.json except that 2027-03-01 is a date exception on every calendar. Sensitivity only; the 40,445-minute benchmark is unchanged.

activity_calendar_rule: Intersection of PROJECT and the calendar of every resource the activity uses. No exceptions.

supply.placement_method: Hypothetical direct chute discharge and manual placement.

C1.formwork_rule: Four vertical faces from 0.0 to 3.0 m (beam soffit). The 3.0-3.5 m node is closed by the beam forms.
C1.reinforcement_boq: HYP-C1-BOQ: explicit 75 kg net B500S software-test line.
